title: Month 2 · the world's turn
headline: A quiet month for the tower: 89 GP in the treasury, still short of anything to buy; the Elves took B1 and the Tieflings built a Treasury.

plan: Morten delved floor 2 under the Humans' A5, next door: XP toward level 4 at low risk.
He spent 62 GP 5 SP at the trader (a Potion of Healing, incense for an owl, rations) and deposited the rest, 22 GP.
The tower took no action: 89 GP buys nothing, so it saves toward 200 GP.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Tieflings (bad: squeezes its own people) finally had the gold and built a Treasury in their seat D5 for 1,200 GP. That's a target worth double on a Rob, three hexes from the tower.

happened.label: good
happened.text: Our ally Goblinkind (good: keeps the peace) sent its last Caravans against the Orcs' Thugs in C2 and lost again (5 vs 8): the Caravans are gone, and the Orcs' Thugs hold on with 1 HP.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Elves (bad: takes land) took the Orcs' B1 without a fight; the Orcs' regime lost 3 HP (22 → 19). It's far to the north and nothing to do with us.

domain.elsewhere: The Orcs bought Knights for their seat D1, and the Gnomes and the Tieflings each finished a goal. Two hidden Cunning moves.

threats: none aimed at the tower; nobody is hostile.
chances: the Elves' seat A2 has no soldiers at home: a Strike does 2d6 to their 16 HP (a High fight, and 6 months of hostility).
the Gnomes' seat D3 is unguarded too, 3 days away (22 HP).
open: floor 3 lies under the Elves' B3 (L3), two days away; floor 4 under the Humans' A3.
the tower has 89 GP and +60 GP a month; everything costs 200 GP or more.

log: Morten: Delve floor 1 under B5 (the dungeon game; no domain effect).
Order: Tieflings C5 (d10 3) · Gnomes C4 (d10 8) · Orcs C4 (d10 2) · Goblinkind C3 (d10 8) · Elves C3 (d10 2) · Humans C3 (d10 2) · Tower C1 (d10 7).
Tieflings (Exarch Iados, bad: squeezes its own people): Buy Treasury a26 in D5 (it has the gold), −1,200 GP → 300 GP.
Orcs (Boss Hruma, bad: robs its neighbours): Buy Knights a27 in D1 (to drive the Elves out of B1), −800 GP → 450 GP.

Goblinkind (Big Boss Zarga, good: keeps the peace): Caravans a8 attacks Orcs' Thugs a2 in C2 → d10 1 + W3 + 1 claim = 5 vs d10 4 + W4 = 8, LOSS. Counter 1d4 3 = 3: Caravans 2 → 0 HP. Caravans a8 destroyed.
Elves (Warden Valanthe, bad: takes land): Seize B1 (L14, Orcs') (goal: take B1 (L14, Orcs')): no defender there; it changes hands at clean-up unless contested.
Humans (Reeve Leopold, good: keeps the peace): saves for Walls (550/600 GP).
Tieflings (Exarch Iados, bad: squeezes its own people): goal done (buy Treasury (1,200 GP)): +1 XP (1).
Gnomes (Tinker-General Ellywick, bad: robs its neighbours): goal done (rob Tieflings' Mercenaries a16 in C5): +1 XP (1).
Elves (Warden Valanthe, bad: takes land): takes B1 (L14) from the Orcs. The regime loses face: 1d4 3 = 3: Orcs HP 22 → 19.
